ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 25% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the median notch and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the primary surface of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a central butterfly-shaped cluster at the median notch and extends in serrated patterns along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; primary peaks concentrated on the medial half of the trailing edge with secondary jagged variations extending to the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical low-intensity linear mark (scratch) located on the left lobe, approximately one-quarter distance from the lateral tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical linear scratch on the left lobe; irregular jagged morphology on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe suggests potential previous physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pigmentation islands that correlate directly with the tips of the serrated trailing edge peaks on the right lobe.
